classes.name: opaque_archive_root
classes.parsed: root identities in RAM, or private pre-cut filename prefix evidence
classes.discarded: post-cut identity/date/count, raw HTML, URLs, schema keys and body hashes
classes.note: fixed current positions; no identity inference, search fallback or resume

classes.name: opaque_archive_dates
classes.parsed: root identities in RAM, or private pre-cut filename prefix evidence
classes.discarded: post-cut identity/date/count, raw HTML, URLs, schema keys and body hashes
classes.note: fixed current positions; no identity inference, search fallback or resume

target_guard: fresh sorted root minus frozen 263; known directories present; no search fallback
retention: private pre-cut filename prefixes and first/last day/count, never verified asset identity
directory_name: only with an exact matching pre-cut filename; otherwise opaque token only
continuity: ordinal similarity proves no linkage to old directories; old M2 remains incomplete
failure: missing ordinal, changed target, invalid schema, integrity or budget stops diagnostic
restart: fresh sibling root only; no resume or modification of sealed roots
publication: aggregates only; private prefix evidence stays outside Git
